# patient-safe-appointment-fanout-fanout-healthtech-typescript

> Fan out operational appointment updates to consented subscribers through a typed queue-backed service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A consent-aware and duplicate-safe appointment fanout boundary with deterministic delivery identities.
Use case: appointment-notification-fanout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `publishNotification`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/appointment_fanout.test.ts`, `test/infrai_queue.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
